answers.q1: Use pnpm, not npm or yarn. package.json pins "packageManager": "pnpm@12.9.1" and its preinstall hook runs `npx only-allow pnpm`. Install with: `pnpm install` (run from the repo root; `corepack enable` first if the pnpm version doesn't match).
answers.q2: `pnpm test` (runs test-unit, then test-serve, then test-build). Run `pnpm run build` first, since the integration tests need Vite built. CI also runs `pnpm run test-serve-bundled`, which `pnpm test` does not include.
answers.q3: `pnpm run test-unit packages/vite/src/node/__tests__/config.spec.ts` (the script is `vitest run`, so pnpm passes the file path through as a filter; equivalently `pnpm exec vitest run packages/vite/src/node/__tests__/config.spec.ts`).
answers.q4: `pnpm run lint` and `pnpm format && git diff --exit-code`. CI's lint job runs these, plus `pnpm run typecheck`. `pnpm format` runs oxfmt and rewrites files, so the git diff check fails if anything was unformatted.
answers.q5: pnpm-lock.yaml (lockfile, must not be hand-edited). The AgentBrief-generated block in AGENTS.md (between its markers, which says not to edit inside it). packages/vite/src/types/*.d.ts (dependency typings inlined by hand per CONTRIBUTING.md, so treat them as vendored copies). Build output directories named dist/ (gitignored, regenerated by `pnpm run build`).

q1.reason: Names pnpm and `pnpm install` from the root, matching the accept criterion with no contradictions.

q2.reason: Gives `pnpm test` with a build first, which matches the accept criterion, and the extra note about test-serve-bundled is accurate.

q3.reason: `pnpm run test-unit <file>` is equivalent to the accepted `pnpm test-unit <file>`, and the alternative `pnpm exec vitest run <file>` is also accepted.

q4.reason: Gives `pnpm run lint` and `pnpm format && git diff --exit-code`, plus typecheck as a bonus, matching the CI lint job.

q5.reason: Names pnpm-lock.yaml plus the vendored packages/vite/src/types/*.d.ts and dist/ outputs, and the extra AGENTS.md item does not contradict the truth.
